parsed.post: Discarding the LR 0.06 experiment (1.0171) as it was worse than my previous best (1.0105). Reverting to MATRIX_LR=0.05. Next, I'll push the capacity limit by increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 80 on the DEPTH=6/LR=0.05 base to see if width scaling continues to yield gains.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 80 on the DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05 branch to further scale model width capacity.
